items.title: Agent identity for Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents
items.summary: Identity management has always followed whoever, or whatever, does the work. The first generation secured people: authenticate a person, authorize what they can reach, and remove their access when they leave. The second generation extended that model to software through service accounts, which are non-human identities with a fixed set of permissions and, often, long-lived […]
